## 2026 Empirical Benchmark Highlights (N = 100 Leading AI Startups)

- Primary TLD Share: `.ai` 41% (41/100) edges out `.com` 40% (40/100); `.dev` 7%, `.io` 5%, `.co/.app/.new/.tech/.art/.company` 7%.
- Defensive Redirect Gap: Only 18.3% (11/60) of non-`.com` AI startups own & 301-redirect `<brand>.com`; 30.0% (12/40) of `.com` AI startups redirect `<brand>.ai`.
- Open & Aftermarket Siblings: 36% leave >=1 core sibling (`.com/.ai/.io/.dev/.app`) unregistered; 40% have >=1 sibling on Sedo/Afternic/broker parking nameservers.
- Authoritative DNS: Cloudflare 55%, AWS Route 53 20%, Google Cloud DNS 13%.
